reporter.title: SimpleMem: Efficient Lifelong Memory for LLM Agents

rows.variant: LoCoMo baseline (Maharana et al. 2024), full conversation in context
rows.notes: CHECK: token-cost column (16,910) identical to A-Mem v1 (arXiv 2502.12110v1) Table 1 GPT-4o-mini 'LoCoMo' row; 1/8 F1/BLEU values coincide position-wise. Paper says the LoCoMo evaluation set has '1,986 questions categorized into four distinct reasoning types' (Sec 3.1, App. B.1): 1,986 is the full 5-category count, but only 4 categories are reported, so the exact question subset is unclear. Baselines: 'we instantiate each baseline and SimpleMem on multiple LLM backends' (Sec 3.1). SimpleMem uses Qwen3-embedding-0.6b + BM25 + metadata, adaptive k in [3,20], memory built by gpt-4.1-mini (Table 7). Token cost per query is in the table (not transcribed as rows).

CHECK: 8/8 category F1/BLEU values and token cost identical to A-Mem v1 (arXiv 2502.12110v1) Table 1 Qwen2.5 1.5b 'LoCoMo' row (A-Mem column order Single/Multi/Temporal/Open = SimpleMem MultiHop/Temporal/OpenDomain/SingleHop). Paper nonetheless says baselines were instantiated by the authors. Paper says the LoCoMo evaluation set has '1,986 questions categorized into four distinct reasoning types' (Sec 3.1, App. B.1): 1,986 is the full 5-category count, but only 4 categories are reported, so the exact question subset is unclear. Baselines: 'we instantiate each baseline and SimpleMem on multiple LLM backends' (Sec 3.1). SimpleMem uses Qwen3-embedding-0.6b + BM25 + metadata, adaptive k in [3,20], memory built by gpt-4.1-mini (Table 7). Token cost per query is in the table (not transcribed as rows).
